A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, although all the schemes are successful in describing the W-production data at the Tevatton, only the CKKW scheme is able to describe the W-production data from the LHC at 7 TeV.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the CKKW prescription for matching matrix elements and parton showers is more robust and less sensitive to the details of the matching procedure.
it is not possible to make universal statements about the relative merits of different approaches to matching.
